svg.title: rocketmq-admin-tui architecture
svg.desc: The main thread runs the event loop, input handling, state, renderer and terminal modes of the RocketMQ admin TUI. Every command runs as a TaskGroup task on a runtime worker, which polls the executor, TuiAdminFacade, rocketmq-admin-core and rocketmq-client call graph against the NameServer, Broker and Controller, and reports progress and its outcome back over channels. Where motion is allowed, a looping animation follows one command from the key press to the frame that shows its result.
svg.text: Terminal administration for RocketMQ Rust. The main thread draws and reads input; every command runs as a runtime task.
draws the interface and reads input; never polls a command
one select! over four sources; draws only the frames that are due
mouse resolved by the hit map
late results ignored by execution id
polls the command; a dropped handle
stops it, and a panic is contained;
drains its client scope, then reports
Send future selected by command id;
Boundary: rocketmq-admin-tui depends on rocketmq-admin-core and never on rocketmq-admin-cli; tests/no_cli_dependency.rs enforces it.
